articles.title: Everything New In Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5
articles.title_tr: Everything New In Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5
articles.summary:
A new season of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is now on Netflix, and to celebrate, Cyberpunk 2077 is getting an update.  Developer CD Projekt Red announced Update 2.5 this week, teasing new items and features inspired by the anime spin-off's second season. 



Beyond that, the studio is keeping mum on the biggest upgrades coming to Cyberpunk 2077 when the update goes live on October 22 for PC, PS5, Switch 2, and Xbox Series X|S.



Since we're feeling impatient and ready to return to Night City, we'll track everything revealed in the dedicated livestream for Update 2.5. Refresh your page to see all the new stuff as it's announced. 



While you're here, you can read more about Edgerunners Season 2, including its punk rock sensibilities, how it mirrors the first season, and the Hideo Kojima cameo lurking in one of the episodes.
